start: Member: Settings, Restore from a backup, 30 workouts on this phone, a MettleUp backup file in Files

steps.action: Tap 'Choose backup file' and pick the file
user_sees: 'In this backup' with a summary of what is in it and who made it
Buttons 'Replace everything on this phone', 'Add to what’s here', 'Choose another file'
must_not: Anything on the phone changed before a choice

steps.action: Tap 'Replace everything on this phone'
user_sees: A sheet 'Delete 30 workouts first?' saying how many are not in the backup and 'A copy is kept while you stay on this screen, so you can undo.'
Button 'Replace'
must_not: Replace starting without the sheet

steps.action: Tap 'Replace'
user_sees: 'Putting back your workouts and routines…' then 'Putting back 12 of 40 photos…'
'Restored 120 workouts, 8 routines, 40 measurements and 40 photos.'
Button 'Undo restore'
must_not: The photo count never moving
Screens still showing the old workouts

start: Member: Welcome screen of a new install, a backup file in Drive

steps.action: Tap 'Restore from a backup', choose the file
user_sees: The same 'In this backup' summary and one 'Restore' button
must_not: The two-choice buttons on an empty phone

steps.action: Tap 'Restore', press Back while it works
user_sees: Back held while it works
Then the restored lines and the app opens
must_not: Back leaving half a restore
An 'Undo restore' button on the welcome screen

start: Member: Settings, Restore from a backup, 30 workouts on this phone, a backup from an old phone with 100 workouts, 20 of them also here

steps.action: Choose the file and tap 'Add to what’s here'
user_sees: 'Restored 80 workouts, …' and '20 workouts were already here, so they were left out.'
must_not: The 20 shared workouts doubled
This phone's settings replaced by the backup's

start: Member: Settings, Restore from a backup

steps.action: Choose a photo or a PDF instead of a backup
user_sees: A buzz and a red line saying why the file cannot be used
'Choose backup file' still there
must_not: Any data changed
A crash

steps.action: Start a workout, choose a good file, tap 'Replace everything on this phone' then 'Replace'
user_sees: 'Finish your workout first: finish or discard the workout in progress, then restore.'
must_not: The open workout lost

steps.action: Restore on a phone with too little space
user_sees: A red line with space needed and free
The choice buttons back
must_not: Half the photos put back with no word

start: Member: Settings, right after 'Replace everything on this phone' finished

steps.action: Tap 'Undo restore'
user_sees: 'Putting this phone back…' then 'Done. This phone is back to how it was before the restore.'
must_not: 'Undo restore' still shown afterwards
The 30 old workouts not all back

steps.action: Restore again, leave the screen, come back
user_sees: 'Choose backup file' only
must_not: An undo offered after leaving when the copy is gone

start: Member: Settings, Restore from a backup, a file sent by a friend on WhatsApp

steps.action: Choose the friend's file
user_sees: Who made it and what is in it, before anything changes
must_not: The friend's phone number or gym membership brought in
The member's gym link replaced by the friend's gym
The picked copy left in the app's cache after leaving the screen
